entries.title: Your crew asks you to keep a key, and you type it into a field only Infinitary draws
entries.body: When a task needs a key, token or password you have not kept, your crew now asks by name and reason, and Infinitary raises its own card with a masked field for each. Type it and press Enter: the value goes straight into Secrets, and the crew gets only its name and reference. You can answer at another Mac you control or on your iPhone or iPad. A card a crewmate writes itself can no longer hold a password field.

picture.alt: Infinitary's card asking to keep a Stripe test key for the Test place and a webhook secret for a task, with the crewmate's reason and two masked fields above Don't keep and Keep in Secrets
